title: Implementation Decision Matrix
description: A 2D matrix helping organizations choose the right intelligent textbook level based on technical capability and data readiness.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the two axes of the decision matrix: technical capability (AI expertise, LLM access) and data readiness (privacy compliance, student data infrastructure)
Explain why most organizations should begin at Level 2 interactive content before pursuing adaptive or chatbot-enabled textbooks
Evaluate an organization's position on the matrix to recommend a target intelligent textbook level
Compare upgrade paths, such as leapfrogging from Level 2 to Level 4 versus the Level 2-3-4 route, based on an organization's privacy compliance strength
